name_zh: 奥云额尔登/矿业巨头：资源诅咒缓解与主权财富建设
name_en: Oyun-Erdene/Mining Giants: Resource Curse Mitigation & Sovereign Wealth Building
description_zh: 罗布勒·奥云额尔登 (1980-) 现任蒙古总理，主导《2020年愿景》与《新复苏政策》，推动陶陶陶铜金矿 (奥尤陶陶) 政府持股 34% 重谈、建立蒙古主权财富基金 (Fiscal Stability Fund/Future Heritage Fund)、推行矿产收益透明化 (EITI)、绿色转型 (戈壁风光/氢能)。核心挑战：单一矿产依赖 (GDP 25%+)、荷兰病风险、外资博弈 (力拓/中国铝业)、基建瓶颈。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解与 M169 后资源转型治理在游牧文明语境下的实战：以"矿产换基建/技术/主权基金"三角博弈，力求将地质运气转化为代际财富。
description_en: Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene (1980-), current Mongolian PM, drives 'Vision 2050' & 'New Recovery Policy', renegotiating Oyu Tolgoi copper-gold mine (34% govt stake), establishing Mongolian SWF (Fiscal Stability Fund/Future Heritage Fund), implementing mineral revenue transparency (EITI), green transition (Gobi wind-solar/hydrogen). Core challenge: single mineral dependency (GDP 25%+), Dutch disease risk, foreign capital games (Rio Tinto/Chalco), infrastructure bottlenecks. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation & M169 Post-Resource Transition Governance in nomadic civilization context: "minerals for infrastructure/tech/sovereign wealth" triangular play, seeking to convert geological luck into intergenerational wealth.
reason_zh: 蒙古拥有世界级铜/煤/稀土，却长期陷入"资源诅咒"。奥云额尔登以 40 岁总理身份，尝试在 M168 工具箱 (SWF/EITI/透明化/绿色转型) 中寻找蒙古解法：既要外资技术/资本，又要主权控制/收益公平/代际公平。这是 M159 游牧契约精神在现代资源治理中的投影——部落共识决定资源归属与分配。
reason_en: Mongolia has world-class copper/coal/rare earths yet long trapped in 'resource curse'. Oyun-Erdene as 40-year-old PM attempts Mongolian solution within M168 toolkit (SWF/EITI/transparency/green transition): needing foreign tech/capital while demanding sovereign control/fair revenue/intergenerational equity. This projects M159 nomadic contract spirit onto modern resource governance—tribal consensus decides resource ownership & distribution.
steps_zh: 重谈陶陶陶合同：2022-23年谈判政府持股 34%、税收稳定、本地就业/采购比例
建立双主权基金：财政稳定基金(抗周期)+未来遗产基金(代际储蓄)，法定只花收益
EITI 透明化深化：矿业合同/收益/实控人公开，接受民间监督
绿色转型锚定：戈壁 10GW 风光+氢能出口走廊，矿区光伏治沙
人才与技术主权：蒙古矿业大学/理工大学建设、本地化技术标准、数据主权
steps_en: Renegotiate Oyu Tolgoi: 2022-23 negotiations for 34% govt stake, tax stability, local employment/procurement quotas
Establish dual SWF: Fiscal Stability Fund (counter-cyclical) + Future Heritage Fund (intergenerational savings), legally spend-only-returns
EITI transparency deepening: mining contracts/revenue/beneficial owners public, civil society oversight
Green transition anchoring: Gobi 10GW wind-solar + hydrogen export corridor, mine-site PV desert greening
Talent & tech sovereignty: Mongolian Univ of Mining/Sci-Tech building, localized tech standards, data sovereignty
expected_zh: 资源型游牧国家实现"矿产财富->主权基金->绿色产业->代际福祉"全链条转化，避免荷兰病，建立可复制的后发资源治理范式。
expected_en: Resource-rich nomadic nation achieves full-chain conversion "mineral wealth->sovereign wealth->green industry->intergenerational wellbeing", avoids Dutch disease, establishes replicable latecomer resource governance paradigm.
case_zh: 陶陶陶铜金矿 2023 产铜 20 万吨/金 15 吨，政府分红超 $10 亿；财政稳定基金 2023 规模 $2.3 亿；EITI 验证蒙古达标；戈壁新能源装机 2023 突破 1GW。
case_en: Oyu Tolgoi 2023 output 200kt Cu/15t Au, govt dividend >$1B; FSF 2023 size $230M; EITI validates Mongolia compliant; Gobi renewables 2023 >1GW installed.
cross_cultural_impact: Landlocked resource nation SWF model; EITI implementation in weak institutions; green hydrogen from mining
resource_curse_mitigation: Oyu Tolgoi 34% stake; Dual SWF (FSF+FHF); EITI compliant; 3% spending rule proposed; Green transition reinvestment
